topic: Finding Costume Fabric and Buttons at the Craft Store

script.title: AT THE FABRIC AISLE
script.scene_zh: 手工藝店 · 挑蝙蝠裝布料
script.story_hook: One bat costume, one very helpful clerk.
script.intro_zh: 一件蝙蝠裝，一位很會幫忙的店員。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the craft store today. Listen for handy shopping phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的手工藝店。留意實用的購物說法。
script.outro: That wraps up the fabric hunt. Listen again and try the lines out loud.
script.outro_zh: 挑布之旅就到這裡。再聽一遍，大膽跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat each line out loud.
script.title_quote: my drawer eats every paper receipt
script.char_a_description: a mother in her early thirties with auburn hair in two short braids, round wire glasses, a cream corduroy jacket over a plain tee, small gold earrings, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man with a silver buzz cut and thick rectangular glasses, wearing a plum craft-store vest over a white shirt, a name tag, and a stocky friendly build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, where's the fabric aisle, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wɛrz ðə ˈfæbrɪk aɪl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問布料區在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle four, past the paint and brushes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɔɹ pæst ðə peɪnt ən ˈbrʌʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 四號走道，經過油漆和筆刷那一區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'm making a bat costume.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪm ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə bæt ˈkɑstuːm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我在做一件蝙蝠裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, for a school play or Halloween?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ fɚ ə skul pleɪ ɔɹ hæləˈwin/
dialogue.zh: 噢，是為了學校表演還是萬聖節？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spring play, but we start early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sprɪŋ pleɪ bʌt wi stɑɹt ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 是春天的表演，不過我們要提早準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart parents always beat the holiday rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈpɛɹənts ˈɔlweɪz biːt ðə ˈhɑlədeɪ ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 有準備的家長都不跟節慶人潮擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, this bat needs wings, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɪs bæt nidz wɪŋz ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，但這件蝙蝠裝需要翅膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Felt sheets make the easiest wings, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛlt ʃits meɪk ði ˈiziəst wɪŋz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，不織布片最適合做翅膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sheets for one pair of wings?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ʃits fɚ wʌn pɛɹ əv wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 一對翅膀需要幾片不織布呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big sheets, plus one black for edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɪɡ ʃits plʌz wʌn blæk fɚ ˈɛdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 兩片大的，再加一片黑色修邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the body fabric, how much do I cut?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈbɑdi ˈfæbrɪk haʊ mʌtʃ du aɪ kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 那衣服的布料呢，要剪多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For one kid, two and a half yards is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ wʌn kɪd tu ænd ə hæf jɑɹdz ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 給一個孩子用，兩碼半就很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read the yardage off the bolt for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju rid ðə ˈjaɹdɪdʒ ɔf ðə boʊlt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我看一下這捲布標示的碼數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This bolt says fifty-four inches wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs boʊlt sɛz ˈfɪfti fɔɹ ˈɪntʃəz waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這捲布標示寬五十四吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it stretchy, or stiff like canvas?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈstɹɛtʃi ɔɹ stɪf laɪk ˈkænvəz/
dialogue.zh: 它有彈性，還是像帆布那麼硬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's stretchy, good for flapping wings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈstɹɛtʃi ɡʊd fɚ ˈflæpɪŋ wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 有彈性，適合做會擺動的翅膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son practiced flapping at breakfast already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn ˈpɹæktɪst ˈflæpɪŋ æt ˈbɹɛkfəst ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我家兒子早餐時就一直揮手臂練上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, kids commit to these things completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kɪdz kəˈmɪt tə ðiz θɪŋz kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，小朋友對這種事可是全程投入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, three black sheets and this bolt then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ θri blæk ʃits ænd ðɪs boʊlt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就三片黑色不織布和這捲布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want matching buttons for the collar?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ˈmætʃɪŋ ˈbʌtənz fɚ ðə ˈkɑləɹ/
dialogue.zh: 領口要不要搭配同色鈕釦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, does that mean I sew them on myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /uː dʌz ðæt min aɪ soʊ ðɛm ɑn maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那是要我自己縫上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sewing's quick with the right needle, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊɪŋz kwɪk wɪð ðə ɹaɪt ˈnidəl doʊnt ˈwɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 針選對了，縫起來很快，不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We only need it to survive one show night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈonli nid ɪt tə sɚˈvaɪv wʌn ʃoʊ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要能撐到演出當晚就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cheap felt and hot glue, no stitching.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃip fɛlt ænd hɑt ɡlu noʊ ˈstɪtʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那就用便宜不織布加熱膠棒，完全不用縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do you sell the glue sticks here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt du ju sɛl ðə ɡlu stɪks hɪɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這裡也賣膠棒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right by the checkout, bottom shelf, grab two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt baɪ ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt ˈbɑtəm ʃɛlf ɡɹæb tu/
dialogue.zh: 就在結帳區旁邊，最下面那層貨架，拿兩支備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, honestly, I'm new at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ ˈɑnəstli aɪm nju æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，你根本是我的救星，我完全是新手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, how dark does the bat fabric need to be?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ dɑɹk du ðə bæt ˈfæbrɪk nid tə bi/
dialogue.zh: 那蝙蝠布的顏色要有多深？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under store lights, everything looks navy to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ stɔɹ laɪts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ lʊks ˈnævi tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 在店內燈光下，什麼東西看起來都像深藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the window end, daylight shows true colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɛnd ˈdeɪlaɪt ʃoz tru ˈkʌləɹz/
dialogue.zh: 拿到靠窗那頭試試，日光下顏色才準確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, this corner has a tiny hole, oh no.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðɪs ˈkɔɹnɚ hæz ə ˈtaɪni hoʊl oʊ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個角上有個小破洞，糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, that bolt's marked down, take ten percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kætʃ ðæt boʊlts mɑɹkt daʊn teɪk tɛn pɚˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 你眼力真好，這捲本來就降價，再減一成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the hole worries me for a whole costume.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə hoʊl ˈwɜɹiz mi fɚ ə hoʊl ˈkɑstuːm/
dialogue.zh: 呃，有個洞，做整件戲服我還是有點擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hole sits where a wing covers it anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl sɪts wɛɹ ə wɪŋ ˈkʌbəɹz ɪt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 況且那個洞的位置，剛好讓翅膀整個遮掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true, bats have wings exactly there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru bæts hæv wɪŋz ɪɡˈzæktli ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也是啦，蝙蝠的翅膀就長在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fold it so the spot hides in the crease.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl foʊld ɪt soʊ ðə spɑt haɪdz ɪn ðə kris/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你摺好，讓那個破洞藏在摺縫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wash the fabric before sewing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɑʃ ðə ˈfæbrɪk bɪˈfɔɹ ˈsoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 請問布料該先洗再縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New fabric shrinks, so yes, cold water, air dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju ˈfæbrɪk ʃɪŋks soʊ jɛs koʊld ˈwɔɾɚ ɛr draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 新布會縮，所以要洗，用冷水，掛著晾乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My machine spins too rough for delicate felt.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ məˈʃin spɪnz tu ɹʌf fɚ ˈdɛləkət fɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 我家洗衣機轉得太猛，不織布會爛掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip the washer, spot clean with a damp cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðə ˈwɑʃɚ spɑt klin wɪð ə dæmp klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 那就不用進洗衣機，用濕布局部擦拭就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and scissors, I don't own real shears.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd ˈsɪzəɹz aɪ doʊnt oʊn ɹiəl ʃiɹz/
dialogue.zh: 好，還有剪刀，我沒有正式的裁布剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kitchen scissors chew fabric, trust me, upgrade here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən ˈsɪzəɹz tʃu ˈfæbrɪk trʌst mi ˈʌpɡɹeɪd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 廚房剪刀會咬布，相信我，就在這裡升級一支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the basic fabric scissors?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ðə ˈbeɪsɪk ˈfæbrɪk ˈsɪzəɹz/
dialogue.zh: 基本款裁布剪刀多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve fifty, and they cut straight through denim.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈfɪfti ænd ðeɪ kʌt streɪ θɹu ˈdɛnɪm/
dialogue.zh: 十二塊五，剪牛仔布就跟切奶油一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, my last scissors broke on stiff canvas.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld maɪ læst ˈsɪzəɹz bɹoʊk ɑn stɪf ˈkænvəz/
dialogue.zh: 買了，我上一把剪刀就是斷在太硬的帆布上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens, thick seams kill cheap blades fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈhæpənz θɪk siːmz kil tʃip bleɪdz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事，厚的縫線讓廉價刀片壞得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last question: can I return things without the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst ˈkwɛstʃən kæn aɪ rɪˈtɝn θɪŋz wɪˈðaʊt ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題：沒帶收據可以退貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With a receipt, exchanges are easy for two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ə rɪˈsit ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒəɹz ɑɹ ˈizi fɚ tu wiːks/
dialogue.zh: 有收據的話，兩週內換貨都很好談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paying cash today, do I get a paper receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪɪŋ kæʃ təˈdeɪ du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈpeɪpɚ rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 我今天付現金，會拿到紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We scan it to your phone, no paper needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi skæn ɪt tə jɔɹ foʊn noʊ ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 我們會掃描傳到你的手機，不用紙本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my drawer eats every paper receipt anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ dɹɔɹ ɪts ˈɛvɹi ˈpeɪpɚ rɪˈsit ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，反正我那個抽屜會吃掉所有紙本收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Store phone works too, just show the cashier your ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔɹ foʊn wɜɹks tu dʒʌst ʃoʊ ðə ˈkæʃiɹ jɔɹ ˌaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 報手機號碼也行，結帳時讓人員看身分證就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've thought of everything, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv θɔt ʌv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你幫我想完所有細節了，非常感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have fun, and save the scraps for practice wings.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv fʌn ænd seɪv ðə skræps fɚ ˈpɹæktəs wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 玩得開心，剩的碎布留下來先練習做翅膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the holiday aisle has bat decorations?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ðə ˈhɑlədeɪ aɪl hæz bæt ˌdɛkəˈɹeɪʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，節慶走道有蝙蝠裝飾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle two, right next to the wrapping paper wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tu ɹaɪt nɛkst tə ðə ˈɹæpɪŋ ˈpeɪpɚ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 二號走道，就在包裝紙牆的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My kitchen will be a bat cave by Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkɪtʃən wɪl bi ə bæt keɪv baɪ ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我廚房到星期天大概會變成蝙蝠洞吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bats bring luck, our staff says every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæts brɪŋ lʌk ˈaʊɚ stæf sɛz ˈɛvɹi jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 蝙蝠招好運，我們店裡每年都這麼講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, then I'll hang two extra by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn aɪl hæŋ tu ˈɛkstɹə baɪ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那我在門口多掛兩隻討個吉利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good luck with the bat, see you next project!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðə bæt si ju nɛkst ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 蝙蝠裝一切順利，下一個作品再見！

script.youtube_title: 【手工店挑布料🦇】「抽屜會吃掉所有收據」教你買布、挑鈕釦、問退貨✂️🎧｜聽完就能自己逛｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Craft Store Fabric Hunt
script.youtube_title_en: My Drawer Eats Every Paper Receipt — Buying Bat Costume Fabric at a Craft Store
script.youtube_description:
「抽屜會吃掉所有收據」——在手藝店的布料區，怎麼把蝙蝠戲服需要的布、不織布、鈕釦一次買齊？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在週末最熱鬧的手工店。

你會聽到：問走道位置、請店員看布捲碼數、判斷布有沒有彈性；發現破洞時怎麼跟店員討論折扣與補救；還有剪刀推薦、洗布提醒、收據掃描進手機等實用說法。

全篇使用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人日常對話的真實語感：um、oh、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：Where's the fabric aisle、How much do I cut、Can I return things、We scan it to your phone。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先熟起來，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My drawer eats every paper receipt" — how do you grab fabric, felt sheets, and buttons for a school-play bat costume in one craft-store run? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the fabric aisle.

You will hear: asking where the aisle is, reading yardage off a bolt, checking if fabric is stretchy; spotting a small hole and talking discounts with the clerk; plus scissor advice, pre-wash tips, and receipts scanned to your phone.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real American rhythm: um, oh, so, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own lines like Where's the fabric aisle, How much do I cut, Can I return things, and We scan it to your phone.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth warm up first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new real-life scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
孩子要演出的蝙蝠裝還差一塊布，走道這麼多，你問得出方向嗎？布捲上的碼數、顏色準不準、甚至上面的小破洞，該怎麼跟店員討論？

這一集帶大家走進週末的手工藝店，從問路、挑布、買不織布與鈕釦，一路聽到破洞折扣、剪刀推薦與收據掃描，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
✂️ 問走道：Hi, where's the fabric aisle, please?
📏 確認用量：And the body fabric, how much do I cut?
🕳️ 發現問題：Hmm, this corner has a tiny hole, oh no.
🧾 退貨對答：With a receipt, exchanges are easy for two weeks.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、so、honestly 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這位媽媽逛完一趟手工店，下次自己走進布料區，話就會自己開口。

祝你下次挑布，一次就挑到剛剛好的那一捲。
